description: Does this passport need a visa for this destination? Returns the requirement, the number of visa-free days, and — when that exact pair has been individually re-verified — the date it was. One pair per call, English only. Prefer it when the user wants a plain yes/no; switch to check_visa_requirement as soon as they need documents, fees, processing times, transit rules, or an answer in another language. Works with NO API key, 10 checks per day per network — the only tool that answers a traveller's question keyless. With a key it costs 1 request. Free API key: https://visa.orizn.app/visa-api/register?source=mcp-remote — 100 requests/month, no card, and it unlocks documents, fees, processing times, transit rules and 15 languages. Then reconnect with the key: https://visa.orizn.app/mcp?key=<key>, or an Authorization: Bearer <key> header.
name: quick_visa_check
